title: From Passive Delegates to Strategic Negotiators: Reinforcing Social Reasoning in Small Language Models with SocialRL
abstract: arXiv:2608.13787v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents increasingly act on their users' behalf, handling tasks such as scheduling meetings, comparing offers, and haggling over prices. These principal-driven tasks routinely place the agent across from a counterpart (another user's agent, a seller, a recruiter) whose goals may conflict with its principal's. Yet the dispositions that make an assistant pleasant can make it a poor delegate: a friendly, helpful frontier model may disclose its principal's private information unprompted and concede at the first sign of resistance. We present SocialRL, a general recipe that trains social reasoning directly, and apply it to a 4B model across six domains: Deal-or-No-Deal, CaSiNo, Craigslist, Job Interview, Calendar, and Marketplace. Every domain is trained in-domain under the same recipe, and every policy is evaluated on all six. translated_title: 从被动代表到战略谈判者：通过SocialRL增强小型语言模型的社会推理能力
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13787v1 公告类型：新 摘要：AI代理越来越多地代表用户行事，处理诸如安排会议、比较报价和讨价还价等任务。这些以委托人为驱动的任务通常使代理面对一个对手（另一个用户的代理、卖家、招聘人员），其目标可能与委托人的目标冲突。然而，使助手讨人喜欢的特质可能使其成为糟糕的代表：一个友好、乐于助人的前沿模型可能未经提示就泄露委托人的私人信息，并在遇到第一个阻力迹象时让步。我们提出了SocialRL，一种直接训练社会推理的通用方法，并将其应用于一个4B模型，涵盖六个领域：交易还是不交易、CaSiNo、Craigslist、求职面试、日历和市场。每个领域都在相同方法下进行领域内训练，每个策略都在所有六个领域进行评估。我们发现（1）领域内训练达到前沿水平：在保留场景中，4B模型匹配或超过GPT-
tldr: 本文提出SocialRL训练方法，使小型语言模型（4B）在六个社会推理领域通过领域内训练达到或超越GPT-4水平，从而从被动代表转变为战略谈判者。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SocialRL, a training recipe that enhances social reasoning in small language models (4B) through in-domain training across six domains, achieving frontier-level performance matching or exceeding GPT-4 and transforming agents from passive delegates to strategic negotiators.
